title: dicerandra frutescens subsp. savannarum
intro: Dicerandra frutescens subsp. savannarum, commonly known as Savanna Blue Dragon, is a plant species within the family Gesneriaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include relieving pain and inflammation, as well as its potential to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Savanna Blue Dragon are attributed to its therapeutic actions, including analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
